source.name: Cotton Down
source.originalDescription: When at least 5% max HP damage is received in a single attack, restores this Pokémon's HP and increases their movement speed by 15% for 1.5s; deals revenge damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and decreases their movement speed by 30% for 1.5s (10s CD). Damages an enemy and decreases its movement speed for a short time after receiving a certain amount of damage. When that happens, also recover HP and gain increased movement speed for a short time.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Cotton Down は 移動速度を下げる、HPを回復する、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, attaching a bit of cotton fluff to opposing Pokémon for 3s and then damaging them. The user and their teammates' auto attacks against targets with cotton fluff on them deal additional damage and decrease their movement speed by 20% for 1s. Each teammate uses their own Sp. Atk to deal additional damage on targets with cotton fluff. This additional damage has an internal cooldown of 0.35s for each teammate. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, attaching a bit of cotton fluff to the enemy. The user's basic attacks against an enemy with cotton fluff on it deal increased damage and decreases the enemies movement speed for a short time.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 攻撃・特攻などのステータスを変化させる、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる、味方へ付着または移動する。

source.name: Leafage
source.originalDescription: The user shoots a bundle of leaves in the designated direction which explodes on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s. Pelt the target with leaves, decreasing the movement speed of enemies for a short time when it hits.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Leafage は 移動速度を下げる、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。

source.name: Cotton Cloud Crash
source.originalDescription: The user becomes invincible as they float into the air for up to 3s, moving freely over obstacles and increasing their movement speed by 10% while in the air. If used again or after 3s, the user pounds the ground, restoring the HP of the user and teammates in the area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and shoving opposing Pokémon hit for 0.7s. Float into the air and become invincible. If used again, pound the ground, attacking and shoving enemies and restoring HP to allies in the area of effect. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Cotton Cloud Crash は 無敵になる、シールドを付与する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ、味方へ付着または移動する、壁・地形・草むらなどと相互作用する。
